snippet.title: BALSEO: The Sea Beyond - Official Reveal Trailer | Folk Horror Stealth Roguelite
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4338640/BALSEO_The_Sea_Beyond/
Venture into the fog if you wish to return. BALSEO: The Sea Beyond is a stealth roguelite inspired by Chilotan mythology. Trapped in a dark dimension, defy the dangers, find allies, and do the impossible to return to your daughter.
